# Test fixtures

- `pomeg_blocks.txt`: box-code blocks extracted from
  [pokemon-ace-notes](https://pomeg-letterbombers.github.io/pokemon-ace-notes/),
  © 2025-2026 Luong Truong (final/togebit) and pokemon-ace-notes contributors,
  licensed [CC BY-SA 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/).
  This file is distributed under the same license.
- `codegenerator_first_ace.txt`: output of E-Sh4rk's
  [CodeGenerator](https://e-sh4rk.github.io/CodeGenerator/) (English Switch, FireRed).
- `local/` (git-ignored): fixtures that may not be redistributed, such as a copy
  of Theocatic's FR/LG custom-script gist. Tests that need them are skipped
  when the folder is missing.
